body: All packages/* build with tsup, ESM-only, target es2022, no splitting, sourcemap+dts. tsup.config 'external' lists react/react-dom + every @filemark/* dep + heavy libs (recharts, mermaid, db-schema-toolkit, @uiw/react-json-view) — intentional so multiple @filemark/* consumers share one runtime instance. @filemark/mdx CSS is NOT bundled: tsup onSuccess does 'cp src/styles.css dist/styles.css', exposed via exports['./styles.css'].
